Comment: Source Control Connector Executor - Durable_Workflow (Step Functions Standard). Triggered by the Prepared_Operation_Store APPROVAL# transition via DynamoDB Streams dispatch, this workflow orchestrates the isolated executor Lambda over an opaque operation_id and records every lifecycle transition to the append-only Audit_Ledger. The authoritative gate sequence (load, hash/contract-version verification, expiry, re-validation, base-revision re-verification, reconcile-before-retry write) lives inside the executor; the workflow invokes it with ONLY operation_id (Req 3.1, 3.3) and durably records transitions (Req 3.3, 8.6). The ${ExecutorFunctionArn} and ${PreparedOperationTableName} tokens are resolved by the gated CloudFormation template (DefinitionSubstitutions).

LoadAndVerify.Comment: Record the workflow-load lifecycle transition to the append-only ledger (insert-only). The authoritative load + Canonical_Hash + Operation_Contract_Version verification is performed inside the executor.

Revalidate.Comment: Record the revalidation lifecycle transition. The executor re-runs capability posture, request-time policy, policy version, enrollment, normalized paths/extensions, Target_Authorization, and base-revision re-verification before any write.

Execute.Comment: Invoke the isolated executor Lambda with ONLY the opaque operation_id (Req 3.3, 4.2, 4.3). No files, target, revision, or free-form instruction are ever passed. The executor is the sole holder of the write credential.

Reconcile.Comment: Route on the executor's terminal outcome. Ambiguous/transient outcomes are reconciled-before-retry INSIDE the executor; here we only branch a successful terminal write to Record and everything else to Rejected.

Rejected.Comment: Record a rejected/failed terminal transition to the ledger. No provider write occurred; the executor already appended its own rejection ledger entry.

Record.Comment: Record the terminal workflow transition to the append-only ledger and end. The append-only records remain the ledger; the workflow only records transitions.
